text: Root cause: `wait_chain.__call__` indexed `self.strategies` using the raw attempt number without clamping it to the number of available strategies, so once `attempt_number` exceeded `len(strategies)` it raised `IndexError` instead of reusing the last strategy as documented. Fixed by clamping the computed index to `len(self.strategies)`.

final_text: Root cause: `wait_chain.__call__` indexed `self.strategies` using the raw attempt number without clamping it to the number of available strategies, so once `attempt_number` exceeded `len(strategies)` it raised `IndexError` instead of reusing the last strategy as documented. Fixed by clamping the computed index to `len(self.strategies)`.
